name: iResolveX
description: Multi-layered indirect call resolution combining static reasoning with learning-augmented refinement for stripped binaries. Published at USENIX Security.

name: DISA
description: Learning-guided static disassembly using attention-based transformers to accurately recover code layout on stripped binaries. Published at ACM CCS 2025.

name: Agent Capability Model (ACaM)
description: A static- and LLM-augmented pipeline that characterizes capability boundaries and attack surfaces of LLM-based autonomous agents.

name: Automated Malware Classifier
description: An ensemble classifier combining static and dynamic analysis for host-based malware detection, deployed at BARC.
